_comment: #396 canonical for `the_makings`, the quest that now wraps the [Hedge Witch] grant. Legs: (1) THE OFFER -- the hub's craft row renders on the peaceful path (exact option-array pin) and the ask inside witch_ask starts the quest, banking heard_the_makings once; (2) THE GATE -- the closer row is ABSENT from the hub between the offer and the beats, which is what keeps witch_lesson's teach option out of reach (that node hangs off makings_kettle alone); (3) GATHER -- hollow_offering_pot's contains_when has opened, so a plain interact fills it (makings_brought, beat 1) where the same press served only the [Basic Cooking] flavor before; (4) TEND -- makings_tend_lamb, the pen's limping third, banks craft_tended (beat 2) and then retires itself on its own absent gate; (5) THE KETTLE -- the closer row now renders, makings_kettle leads into the shipped witch_lesson, and its teach option is finally visible and banks witch_lessons (beat 3 + quest_completed); (6) THE GAIN -- a real sleep grants [Hedge Witch] off that same frozen counter. Then (7) THE GRADUATE REPLAY (review M3) walks the run's own end state back to her: the closer row has retired, witch_ask's APPENDED re-entry reaches witch_lesson, and the teach option is pinned ABSENT with both beats banked -- so hide_when witch_lessons is the only gate holding it and deleting that key reds this leg. (8) THE LEGACY GRADUATE loads makings_graduate_start (witch_lessons 1, heard_the_makings 0), the pre-#396 cohort the starter's old heard_the_makings gate still rendered for: no starter row, no press that can start the quest, started_quests stays empty. Then the NEGATIVE leg swaps in the force-path save (drove_off_collectors) through the pause-menu Load path (thread_lattice_loop idiom) and pins the hub array WITHOUT the craft row. Shots 01/02 are the eye-gate for the pot and for the pen reading as a pen (two ewe lambs + the limping third).
